item.title: ANTONIO SKARMETA
item.description:
Antonio Skarmeta obtained his PhD in Computer Science in 1995 and has been a Professor of Telematics Engineering since 2009.

He has served as Vice-Rector for Infrastructure at the Faculty and as Director of the Department of Information and Communications Engineering.

He coordinates the PhD program in Advanced Information and Telematics Technologies and the European Projects Office at the University of Murcia.

He currently leads the Intelligent Systems and Telematics research group and participates in scientific committees and European projects.

item.title: JORGE BERNAL
item.description:
Jorge Bernal Bernabé holds an MSc, Master’s, and PhD in Computer Science, as well as an MBA from the University of Murcia (Spain). He was accredited as a Full Professor by ANECA in 2020 and received the Best Doctoral Thesis Award from the School of Computer Science in 2015.

In 2017, he was awarded a postdoctoral research fellowship funded by INCIBE, and in 2019, an AXA Research Fund postdoctoral fellowship. Since February 2023, he has been a Full Professor in the Department of Information and Communications Engineering.
